title: Stabilize workflow test time-window baseline
description: The onboarding branch cannot pass the repository pre-push hook because workflow mining and judging tests use July 2026 fixtures while the 30-day selection window is evaluated against the current date. On 2026-08-11, the full suite reports 675 passed and 24 failures with zero or undefined candidates. Diagnose and correct the repository test baseline without bypassing hooks or changing production behavior merely to mask the failures.
acceptance_criteria: Full PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:$PATH" script/test passes on the current date; git push -u origin HEAD succeeds without --no-verify; onboarding branch can then be published.
notes: Discovered during Workspace Harness onboarding. Preserve chore/onboard-workspace-contract at commit a68cdab; do not force-push or bypass pre-push checks.
